They shape products used by some of the most advanced data teams in the world, and increasingly by the business users and AI agents working alongside them.</p> <p>We're hiring Product Designers to join our design team and own design for an area of the Databricks Platform. Teams span the platform, from data engineering and analytics to databases, apps, and AI agents. We match each designer to the area where their skills and interests will have the most impact. You will explore consumer behaviour, social conversations, creator activity, competitor performance and cultural trends, turning your findings into compelling stories and practical recommendations. This is an early-career opportunity suited to someone with one to two years of marketing, research, social media or insights experience who is curious about audiences, brands and culture.</p> emerging cultural trends.</li> <li>Review campaign results and relevant performance indicators to identify key themes, patterns and opportunities.</li> <li>Bring together information from multiple sources and translate findings into clear, engaging insight stories.</li> <li>Support the development of practical recommendations for campaign planning, creator strategy and content development.</li> <li>Use social listening, audience intelligence and research platforms to gather relevant information, with guidance from senior team members.</li> <li>Maintain a high standard of accuracy and attention to detail across all research and reporting.</li> </ul> <h3>Project & Stakeholder Management:</h3> <ul> <li>Support defined intelligence and insights projects, from initial research and information gathering through to final delivery.</li> <li>Manage assigned tasks and deadlines, raising questions or potential issues with senior team members when required.</li> <li>Collaborate effectively with strategy, planning, campaign and client teams to understand their intelligence needs.</li> <li>Communicate findings clearly and confidently to internal stakeholders, with support where appropriate.</li> <li>Respond positively to feedback and use it to strengthen future research and insight development.</li> </ul> <h3>Learning & Best Practice:</h3> <ul> <li>Build knowledge of influencer marketing, social platforms, creator culture and the wider media landscape.</li> <li>Develop confidence in research, insight generation and storytelling techniques through hands-on experience and team support.</li> <li>Stay informed about emerging platforms, consumer behaviours, cultural shifts and industry developments.</li> <li>Contribute ideas, examples and useful resources that support the team’s shared knowledge.</li> <li>Follow established research standards and best practices, including accurate sourcing and clear documentation.</li> </ul> <h2>Key Responsibilities:</h2> <h3>Intelligence & Research Operations:</h3> <ul> <li>Conduct desk research using reliable sources to support campaign briefs, pitches, reports and strategic projects.</li> <li>Monitor social conversations, creator activity, competitor behaviour and category developments to identify relevant insights.</li> <li>Help produce regular intelligence outputs, including trend reports, competitor reviews, audience summaries and campaign learnings.</li> <li>Gather and organise information from internal and external sources, ensuring findings are clearly documented and easy to understand.</li> <li>Support the maintenance of campaign tracking documents, research libraries and shared intelligence resources.</li> <li>Ensure campaigns and relevant information are added promptly to internal platforms, following up with stakeholders when details are missing.</li> </ul> <h3>Insight Development & Quality:</h3> <ul> <li>Identify meaningful themes and patterns within research, social conversations and campaign information.</li> <li>Help turn observations into insights by explaining what is happening, why it matters and how brands could respond.</li> <li>Sense-check findings to ensure conclusions are supported by appropriate evidence.</li> <li>Check sources, calculations, formatting and written outputs carefully before sharing work.</li> <li>Ask thoughtful questions and seek guidance when information is incomplete, unclear or inconsistent.</li> </ul> <h3>Platform & Application Knowledge:</h3> <ul> <li>Develop working knowledge of our core intelligence, campaign and reporting applications, including Benchmark Index, Performance Analyser and Deliverables Calculator.</li> <li>Use social listening, audience intelligence and research tools to gather information and identify relevant trends.</li> <li>Confidently use Excel or Google Sheets for organising information, completing basic analysis and producing clear summaries.</li> <li>Navigate our BI and internal reporting tools to access existing information and dashboards, with training and support provided.</li> <li>Share feedback on internal tools and processes to help improve usability and team efficiency.</li> </ul> <h3>Collaboration & Development:</h3> <ul> <li>Work closely with colleagues across Intelligence and Insights, Strategy, Campaigns and other relevant teams.</li> <li>Communicate clearly and proactively to help ensure actions are completed and projects remain on track.</li> <li>Participate in team discussions and contribute a curious, audience-focused perspective.</li> <li>Build effective working relationships by being dependable, collaborative and open to feedback.</li> <li>Take ownership of personal development and actively build knowledge of the influencer marketing and social media landscape.</li> </ul> <h2>The Ideal Candidate:</h2> <ul> <li>One to two years of experience in marketing, consumer research, social media, trends.</li> <li>Curiosity and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to look beyond surface-level observations and consider why something matters.</li> <li>Some experience conducting desk research, competitor analysis, social listening or campaign reporting.</li> <li>An ability to turn research and information into clear, concise and engaging stories.</li> <li>Good written and verbal communication skills, with a willingness to build confidence in presenting findings.</li> <li>Strong organisational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.</li> <li>Working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets; experience with social listening, research or audience intelligence tools would be beneficial but is not essential.</li> <li>A It’s demanding – but always rewarding.</p> <p>WPP 650 is a bespoke agency unit within WPP, dedicated to serving the evolving communications needs of government clients. platform training sessions to further develop your paid social skillset. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Operational Excellence</strong> </p> <ul> <li>Responsible for managing your workload and for with line-manager and to ensure processes are followed, allowing for prompt payment/invoicing and to minimise finance queries. </li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Skills and DTA is responsible for servicing clients with best-in-class data solutions, data strategy, analytics, technology and AI solutions to drive client growth. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection.</p> <p><strong>Who We Are Looking For</strong></p> <p>We are seeking an Analytics Manager to join our growing Analytics & Data Science team, reporting into the Data Tech and Analytics global lead. The team focuses on media effectiveness measurement, campaign analysis and client communication to help make brands become more valuable to the world.<br><br>You will be working with a leading advertiser, JLR, to harness their data and improve the performance of their campaigns, developing and deploying media measurement solutions. Communication with client stakeholders and effective management of assigned tasks is critical in this role. You will be joining an award winning team, with more than 16 tech and media industry awards to our name, including Campaign Magazine's Tech Awards Agency of the Year, Best Use of AI, and Breakthrough Tech as Part of a Campaign awards.<br><br>We have invested in giving you the tools to make you as successful as possible, including training/development, full access to Google Cloud Platform and a wider global community of analysts and data scientists.<br><br><strong>Some of the things we'd like you to do</strong><br><br></p> <p><strong>Strategic Analytics Application:</strong> Build and apply a deep understanding of marketing objectives to support Account teams with comprehensive measurement and testing plans. To help deliver "best in class" analytical capabilities across the agency with the wider Analytics team, including the use of new methods, techniques, tools and systems. Managing the process through to delivery and taking ownership of global roll out.</p> <p><strong>Marketing & Business Effectiveness: </strong>Lead the creation of clear, robust and thought-provoking campaign reviews and insights, and show the wider team/clients how to improve effectiveness. Deliver insightful campaign reviews with actionable recommendations to improve marketing effectiveness.</p> <p><strong>Measurement frameworks & Experimentation:</strong> Develop deep understanding of marketing platform testing and targeting abilities, and act in a consultative capacity in their implementation. Provide actionable insights and design experiments to optimise campaign performance - focusing on brand and conversion lift studies.</p> <p><strong>Client Stakeholder Engagement:</strong> Build trusted relationships with client’s marketing, analytics, and data leads, acting as a knowledgeable and credible day-to-day strategic partner.</p> <p><strong>Internal Stakeholder Engagement:</strong> Manage relationships with data engineering teams and set automation strategies to integrate new tools and solutions.</p> <p><strong>Commercial Contribution:</strong> Support the commercial health of your client account by contributing to the scoping and delivery of high-value analytics projects. Participate in new business pitches, helping to develop data and tech solutions that demonstrate the value of WPP Media’s capabilities. Coordinate with third-party vendors for the assessment and management of bespoke measurement solutions, including contracts and SOWs.</p> <p><strong>Thought Leaderhsip:</strong> Translate complex data concepts for stakeholders and contribute to the company's data strategy, promoting data-driven innovation within the media industry.</p> <p><strong>Skills & Qualifications</strong></p> <p>At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. Holding a degree(s) in a quantitative field: Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, Physical Science or Computer Science</li> <li>Experience in analytics, measurement, data science, or a related field</li> <li>Knowledge of applying measurement to media campaigns through Meta/Google, through brand and conversion lift studies, matched market tests or otherwise</li> <li>Well-developed problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically and creatively</li> <li>Strong understanding of statistics including hypothesis testing, descriptive statistics and distribution theory</li> <li>Strong communication skills, with the ability to present complex ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences</li> <li>Able to work independently and as part of a cross-functional team, using project management tools such as Jira/Trello. Ability to project manage analytics projects.</li> <li>Highly capable at presenting data in a visually engaging and insightful manner that cuts through the noise</li> <li>Experience in mentorship and management, ability to display empathy in difficult situations and lead by example</li> <li>Stay up-to-date with the latest industry trends and advancements in data science and analytics</li> <li>Proficiency in SQL & R/Python, including understanding of packages such as pandas, numpy, scipy & matplotlib.</li> <li>Strong understanding of what data points can be collected and analysed in a digital campaign, and how each data point should be analysed. Including knowledge of media data and incremental measurement, including both Direct Response and Brand campaigns</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Working knowledge of advanced measurement tools including MMM, MTA, Sales Lift, and Brand Studies.</li> </ul> <p><span data-contrast="auto">#LI-Promoted</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":276}"> </span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Associate Director, Activation & Delivery, GCS
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.</p> <p>WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com</p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Search & Ecommerce Account Director to lead the strategic development, execution, and performance of integrated biddable activity across <strong>Google Ads (Search, Shopping, Performance Max)</strong> and <strong>Amazon Search</strong>.</p> <p>As a senior leader within the team, you will be responsible for <strong>defining and delivering best-in-class search and ecommerce strategies</strong>, ensuring alignment with broader client business goals and full-funnel media objectives.</p> <p>You will act as the <strong>senior client contact</strong>, working with stakeholders at Director level and above, while leading cross-functional teams and offshore delivery hubs to execute against strategy.</p> <p>This role combines <strong>deep platform expertise, strategic leadership, and operational oversight</strong>, ensuring campaigns are executed to the highest standard while continuously driving innovation and growth.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities: </strong></p> <p><strong>Strategic Leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the development of holistic Search & Ecommerce strategies across: <ul> <li>Google Ads (Search, Shopping, Performance Max)</li> <li>Amazon Search (Sponsored Ads ecosystem)</li> </ul> </li> <li>Ensure strategies are aligned to client business objectives, KPIs, and commercial priorities</li> <li>Translate broader marketing strategy into channel-specific activation frameworks</li> <li>Identify growth opportunities across demand capture (Search) and retail media (Amazon)</li> <li>Drive integration between Search, Ecommerce, and wider media channels (Paid Social, Programmatic, SEO)</li> <li>Develop forward-thinking POVs on industry trends, platform developments, and emerging opportunities</li> </ul> <p><strong>Client and Stakeholder Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as the primary senior contact for Search & Ecommerce across your client portfolio</li> <li>Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders, becoming a trusted strategic advisor</li> <li>Lead client meetings, presentations, quarterly reviews, and strategic planning sessions</li> <li>Clearly articulate performance, insights, and forward strategy</li> <li>Identify opportunities to grow client investment and expand scope</li> </ul> <p><strong> Performance and Campaign</strong></p> <ul> <li>Maintain ultimate accountability for performance delivery across all Search & Ecommerce activity</li> <li>Oversee campaign execution across Google Ads and Amazon platforms, ensuring alignment with strategy <ul> <li>Ensure robust optimisation frameworks are in place across:</li> <li>Bidding & automation (e.g., Smart Bidding, PMAX optimisation)</li> <li>Feed optimisation (Shopping / Amazon)</li> <li>Query, audience, and keyword strategies</li> </ul> </li> <li>Lead performance reviews, identifying risks and opportunities</li> <li>Ensure rigorous testing frameworks are defined and executed</li> <li>Ensure all campaigns are delivered <strong>on time, within budget, and to the highest standards</strong></li> <li>Maintain strong governance across: <ul> <li>QA processes</li> <li>Financial management and invoicing</li> <li>Platform best practice adherence</li> </ul> </li> <li>Drive improvements in workflows, automation, and efficiency</li> <li>Ensure clear documentation of processes and ways of working</li> <li>Lead development of <strong>test & learn roadmaps</strong> across Search and Ecommerce</li> <li>Identify opportunities to leverage new platform capabilities (e.g., PMAX, AI bidding, Amazon innovations)</li> <li>Contribute to agency thought leadership, case studies, and award submissions</li> <li>Actively participate in the wider Search and Commerce communities within WPP Media</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Onshore–Offshore Delivery Model</strong></p> <ul> <li>Define and manage ways of working between onshore strategy teams and offshore execution teams</li> <li>Ensure offshore teams are set up for success with: <ul> <li>Clear briefs</li> <li>Defined processes</li> <li>QA frameworks and performance standards</li> </ul> </li> <li>Oversee output quality across offshore Account Managers and Executives</li> <li>Drive scalability, efficiency, and operational excellence across delivery</li> <li>Lead and develop a team of Account Managers and Account Executives (onshore and offshore)</li> <li>Provide coaching, mentorship, and performance management</li> <li>Ensure effective workload allocation, prioritisation, and delivery</li> <li>Support hiring and team growth aligned to client needs</li> <li>Foster a high-performing, collaborative, and innovative team culture</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong> Skills & Experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Extensive experience across: <ul> <li>Google Ads (Search, Shopping, Performance Max)</li> <li>Amazon Search / Retail Media ecosystems</li> </ul> </li> <li>Proven track record of leading performance-driven search and ecommerce strategies</li> <li>Strong understanding of full-funnel media strategy and cross-channel integration</li> <li>Advanced analytical skills with ability to translate data into actionable insights</li> <li>Experience managing large-scale, complex accounts and budgets</li> <li>Strong client leadership experience, including senior stakeholder management</li> <li>Experience managing and developing multi-layered teams (including offshore models)</li> <li>Deep understanding of bidding strategies, feed-based media, automation, and measurement</li> <li>Strong communication and presentation skills</li> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media & Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we're just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.</p> <p> </p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.</p> <p> </p> <p>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</p> <p> </p> <p>Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location</p> <p> </p> <p>Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy) for more information on how we process the information you provide.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":276}"> </span></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

You would have excellent oral and written communication skills, be client obsessed, self-motivated and able to operate both as a team and independently with limited guidance and direction</p> <p>The Manager, Client Analytics is following the direction of Director of Analytics and is responsible for data manipulation and visualization, performing quantitative data analysis, problem solving, statistical modeling, and developing/analysing business cases.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU WILL DO</strong>  </p> <ul> <li>Apply deep knowledge of basic statistics (significance testing, correlation analysis, confidence intervals, descriptive statistics) to support analytical solutions.</li> <li>Use statistical modeling techniques (regression, classification) to extract business value from campaign data.</li> <li>Utilize programming languages (Python, R, SQL), statistical packages (SciPy), and Google tools (BigQuery, Tensorflow, Datalab) to prototype and deliver data-driven solutions.</li> <li>Recommend and develop technical solutions with guidance from senior leadership.</li> <li>Define project scope, setup, and effort estimation in collaboration with the account Analytics lead.</li> <li>Build and maintain strong relationships with Analytics leads and gain a deep understanding of client challenges.</li> <li>Work closely with key stakeholders to assess project needs and ensure delivery of best-in-class analytics work.</li> <li>Collaborate with regional leadership on process development, improvement, and compliance.</li> <li>Support campaign measurement, determine incremental lift from marketing activities, and manage reporting and data needs (ingestion, cleaning, delivery).</li> <li>Code in SQL and Python to create reports and build dashboards; automate recurring workloads to improve efficiency.</li> <li>Generate meaningful insights using advanced analytics/statistical techniques; create dashboards and presentations for wider teams.</li> <li>Ensure continuous collaboration and progression across bands, disciplines, and offices.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong>  </p> <ul> <li>Relevant industry experience in analytics-focused roles.</li> <li>Degree in an applied quantitative field (data science, mathematics, statistics, engineering, economics, business management, computer science, or related).</li> <li>Understanding of marketing campaigns, objectives, and measurement techniques; prior experience in digital agency or consulting preferred.</li> <li>Proficient coding skills in statistical software (R, Python, SciPy), programming languages (SQL, Python), and MS Office tools (especially advanced Excel/Google Sheets).</li> <li>Experience in owning and delivering analytics projects, including correlation, regression, significance testing, A/B tests, and supervised machine learning.</li> <li>Practical understanding of data science techniques, statistical analysis, and modeling.</li> <li>Passion for data analysis, troubleshooting data anomalies, integrating data from multiple sources to create repositories for data science models.</li> <li>Ability to transform raw data into actionable business insights for decision-making and strategic planning.</li> <li>Strong logical thinking, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.</li> <li>Excellent verbal and written communication skills.</li> <li>Adherence to quality standards and ability to plan and prioritize work.</li> <li>Experience using or building reports with business intelligence tools is a plus.</li> <li>Experience in applying big data, statistics, and analytical techniques to solve client problems is preferred.</li> <li>Business acumen to provide actionable strategic recommendations is preferred</li> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media & Benefits</strong> </p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Who we are</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. The window to build something significant is open right now. </li> <li><strong>Sharpen Your Edge:</strong> Access elite enablement — Command the Message and MEDDPICC coaching — built to make you a more effective closer.</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p>Minimum Requirements for the role:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Winning DNA:</strong> Minimum 18 months+ closing experience in an outbound-heavy SaaS environment. You must have a proven history of building your own pipe from scratch.</li> <li><strong>Over-achievement:</strong> A track record of hitting and exceeding quota in a competitive, complex environment</li> <li><strong>Strategic Grit:</strong> Experience managing multi-stakeholder deal cycles and technical POCs. We value your ability to hunt</li> <li><strong>Native German</strong> language speakers</li> </ul> <p>Advantageous:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Intellectual Curiosity:</strong> You are eager to learn the inner workings of diverse industries, from waste management to food distribution, to better align our technology with their operational pain.</li> <li><strong>A Repeatable Sales Framework:</strong> You don’t rely on luck or intuition. You have a structured methodology that delivers success and you understand that consistent, high-quality inputs lead to predictable results.</li> <li><strong>A Data-Minded Approach:</strong> You are a student of your own funnel. You understand how to structure your activity—prospecting volume, discovery depth, and multi-threading—to ensure a consistent output and forecast accuracy.</li> <li><strong>Continuous Process Iteration:</strong> You possess a relentless drive for self-improvement. You are someone who actively seeks feedback, iterates on their approach, and understands that evolving your tactics is the only way to stay ahead of the market.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Total Rewards</strong></p> <p>At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. title: Deployed Engineer
description: Wordsmith Wordsmith is building the legal operating system for in-house teams, and we are growing fast. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still too often scattered across inboxes, chats, documents and disconnected systems. Wordsmith brings that work into one system. Requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgement matters, and every step is captured as work happens. We are built for in-house legal, not law firms. Our goal is to help legal teams move faster, reduce unnecessary external counsel spend and become a function the business can run with. More than 500 companies, including Financial Times, Safelite, Trip.com , Canva, Starling and Sage, use Wordsmith. Backed by over $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe and others, we are building one of the defining companies in legal AI . The role Deployment Engineers own the technical side of getting Wordsmith live inside a customer. Once a deal is signed, you’ll connect Wordsmith to the systems our customers already run on. That means identity and SSO, Microsoft 365 and SharePoint, Google Workspace, Salesforce, document management, chat tools, and MCP connections to the wider AI and data stack. You’ll design how data and permissions flow between them, build and test the integrations, and work through each customer’s IT and security requirements until everything works in production. It’s part integration engineering, part solutions architecture, and part customer-facing problem solving. You’ll be the technical lead on every deployment you own, the person customer IT teams talk to, and the person who works out how to make it work when an integration doesn’t behave as documented. This is a technical, hands-on role. You don’t need to be a lawyer, and we’re not necessarily looking for one. We’re looking for engineers and technical consultants who understand identity, APIs and enterprise SaaS, and who enjoy making systems talk to each other. Your focus is the technical foundation the rest of the deployment runs on. You’ll work side by side with our Legal Engineers on every deployment. While you connect Wordsmith to the customer’s systems, they configure the platform itself: workflows, agents, playbooks and automations built around how the legal team works. You’ll plan the deployment together, agree what each integration needs to support, and make sure the connections you build give their configuration the data, documents and permissions it depends on. What you’ll do 1. Integrations Own the integrations for each deployment, including SSO and SCIM, Microsoft 365, SharePoint and OneDrive, Google Workspace, Salesforce, document management and chat tools Configure and connect Wordsmith to customers’ wider AI and data stack through MCP Build, test and harden integrations so they hold up in production, not just in a demo 2. Identity, Security & Access Set up identity and access, including SSO with Okta, Entra ID and Google, user provisioning, roles and permissions Work through customers’ security reviews, IT questionnaires and data-handling requirements Make sure permissions in Wordsmith respect the permissions in the systems it connects to 3. Technical Solution Design Take the technical handover from Sales and confirm the customer’s systems landscape, constraints and integration scope Design how data, documents and requests flow between Wordsmith and the customer’s tools Advise customer IT on the right architecture for their environment and where the trade-offs sit Work with Legal Engineers to agree what each integration needs to support the workflows, agents and playbooks they’re configuring 4. Technical Delivery & Escalation Lead the technical workstream of each deployment, from environment setup and integration build through testing to go-live Diagnose and fix integration issues, and act as the escalation point for technical problems during rollout Know when a problem needs Engineering, and bring them a clear, reproducible case 5. Improve How We Integrate Turn what you learn into reusable integration patterns, setup guides and technical runbooks Feed connector gaps, API limitations and recurring requests back to Product and Engineering What we’re looking for Hands-on experience deploying and integrating enterprise SaaS in customer environments Strong working knowledge of identity and access, including SSO (SAML, OIDC), SCIM provisioning, Okta, Entra ID or Google Workspace Experience integrating with the Microsoft 365 and SharePoint, Google Workspace or Salesforce ecosystems Comfortable with APIs, webhooks, authentication flows and reading technical documentation. You can script or write code where it helps Familiarity with MCP or other ways of connecting AI systems to tools and data, or a strong appetite to learn Credible with customer IT and security teams. You can answer their questions and stand behind your architecture Methodical troubleshooter who isolates problems, reproduces them and fixes them Clear communicator who can explain a technical decision to a non-technical stakeholder Typical backgrounds include Deployment, integration or implementation engineers in SaaS Solutions engineers or solutions architects Technical consultants with Microsoft 365, Google Workspace or Salesforce experience IT or identity engineers who have moved into customer-facing roles How we work We’re an in-person team based in Edinburgh or London. You should expect to work from the office or visit customers as your default. We set a high bar, move quickly and give people meaningful ownership. There will not always be an established playbook, so you’ll need to bring curiosity, structure and persistence to unfamiliar situations. You’ll sit in the Transformation team, reporting to the VP of Transformation, and work closely with our Legal Engineers, alongside Legal Intelligence, Enablement, Customer Success, Support Engineering and Product. Our customer teams have clear but closely connected responsibilities: Transformation leads implementation, Support Engineering resolves technical issues, Account Management owns renewals and commercial growth, Customer Success owns adoption, customer health and value realisation, and Enablement owns onboarding, training and customer capability. Why Wordsmith Wordsmith is growing quickly, winning new customers and expanding within larger organisations. Wordsmith is only as useful as the systems it connects to. Every new customer brings a different stack, and Deployment Engineers are the people who make Wordsmith work inside it. You’ll work directly with ambitious in-house legal teams, see how dozens of legal functions really operate, and take that back into a product you help shape. You will work across enterprise identity, productivity and CRM platforms, and on MCP as it develops into a standard. You will own real technical outcomes from your first week and help define how we integrate as we scale. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><a href="https://fin.ai/">Fin</a>, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.</p> <p>Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.</p> <p>Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.</p></div><h2>What's the opportunity? </h2> <p>Self-serve is where the majority of our customers start their journey, and the Growth team owns that journey end to end. <strong>This role owns the self-serve</strong> <strong>existing business</strong>: once a customer converts to paid, the account is yours - through every stage of its lifecycle, as it adopts more of the platform, grows its usage, and deepens its reliance on Fin.</p> <p>Your mandate is to grow the value of the self-serve base: drive expansion, strengthen retention, and accelerate adoption of Fin and our newest products across thousands of paying customers. You'll own a book of business, a roadmap, and a cross-functional motion that spans product, lifecycle, data, and go-to-market. from the moment a customer converts to the point they renew, expand, or leave - and be accountable for the net growth of that book.</li> <li><strong>Grow Fin adoption.</strong> Get more customers using our AI Agent across the existing base, and help the customers who already use it automate more of their support.</li> <li><strong>Defend and expand.</strong> Build the retention and expansion motions that grow the book - Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.</p> <p>In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. title: Chief Customer Officer
description: Work from anywhere, impact everywhere Diversity is at the heart of who we are at Xapo Bank. We're a fully distributed team of over 160 Xapiens that work remotely from 50+ countries around the world. Our beginning: A world that enjoys economic freedom and wealth protection,no matter where you live or who is running your country. To achieve that, we search the world for the best people for the job. We work hard, think globally, and inspire each other to learn and grow. We are committed to changing the way things are done. Although we are headquartered in Gibraltar, this is a full time, 100% remote position Work from anywhere! Position overview Xapo's product suite has grown from a Bitcoin vault into a full member proposition: BTC and USD accounts that pay interest, a global card with Bitcoin cashback, Bitcoin-backed loans, a growing suite of BTC wealth and credit products, and access to stocks, ETFs, and stablecoins, all inside one regulated relationship. Xapo is a bank, and a bank earns on the money its members choose to hold with it. Each of those products shipped well. What hasn't yet existed is a single owner of the economics of the customer relationship: one person accountable for winning the right members, growing what they hold with us, and keeping them, and for the balance-sheet products that make that possible. The Chief Customer Officer is a new role at the top of the house, reporting to the CEO. You will run the stream that grows what members hold with Xapo, and you will own the Customer P&L, retail and institutional. It brings growth, client coverage, product management, and product design under one leader who is judged on customer contribution, the assets attracted and kept, and the members who stay. This is a customer-focused role in the most commercial sense: what a member earns from us, not the feature we shipped, is the centre of every decision. The measure of success is a Customer P&L that grows on what members hold and keep: LTV:CAC improving, approved-to-paid rising, churn falling, and customer contribution the business can plan against. This is a banking role, not a requirements-gathering role, a marketing role, or a role you can run from a dashboard. Products are priced on the balance sheet and judged on the money they attract and keep. The mandate Own the Customer P&L, retail and institutional. You own customer contribution: customer gross profit from what members' balances earn, secured lending, Bitcoin yield, and conversion, stocks and ETFs, less the cost of winning and keeping members. We earn on what members hold, not on what they tap, send, or click, so you run on assets held and the margin they earn, not payment volume. Good looks like a Customer P&L the Exco and Board can plan against, where every line has a number you own and can explain, up or down. Grow what members hold with us, through earning products run like a banker would. You own the roadmap for the balance-sheet products: deposits and savings, lending and credit, and trading and structured. Each is led by a mission PM who is a banker, owning a product's contribution and its price on the balance sheet, not a backlog. Requirements go through the gate; the economics are the job. Every item is priced by Finance before it is built, on a shared risk appetite with Risk and Treasury. Good looks like products that scale assets held and member lifetime value at a risk profile the Board actually approved. Win the right members, efficiently. You own Growth: audience, lifecycle, and content, with one head accountable for the path from approval to paid. You own CAC and approved-to-paid, find the members who bring other members, and activate them in week one. Every incentive is priced before it runs. Good looks like net paid-member growth that improves every quarter, at a CAC that LTV comfortably justifies, because you diagnosed where the funnel leaks rather than spending more to fill it. Keep members, and deepen the relationship with the ones who hold balances. Retention is the most efficient growth we have. You own churn, and you own Client Coverage: relationship managers who sell the missions' products to the members who hold balances, and loop demand back into the roadmap. You are accountable for net new AUM flow, covered-book retention, and products per covered member, and for growth that is broad-based rather than concentrated in a few accounts. Good looks like falling churn and AUM growth from members who stay and expand rather than members re-acquired at cost. Make the value of Xapo visible, and the experience effortless. You own Product Design: one design system and one shell, so that members see the value of what they are earning clearly and early, and find every task simple. You design the proposition in the stream with Finance and partner with Operations, who run onboarding, KYC, support, cards, and payments, to remove friction at the points that affect members most. Good looks like members who understand their return, complete what they set out to do, and stay. Build one Customer organisation, not four. Growth, Client Coverage, Mission PMs, and Product Design come together under one operating model: one set of key results read weekly from one source, shared frameworks for discovery and prioritisation, and real career paths for the people in it. Engineering is pulled to a single ranked roadmap, and nobody in your line has engineers of their own. Good looks like fewer hand-offs per outcome and a number for every cell that its owner explains every week. Bring the regulated-bank and crypto-native lens to every customer call. You understand that a KYC onboarding decision and an AML monitoring decision carry different risk appetites, that a false positive at the gate is a paid-for member lost, and that a proposition built for a crypto-native power user can still fail a first-time bank customer. You can sit in the same room as a CRO, an MLRO, a CFO, and an engineering lead and make a customer case that survives all four conversations. How you'll operate This part matters as much as the mandate. The known failure mode for this role, in any company, is a CCO with a polished customer-insight deck and no ownership of the number. That is disqualifying here. You lead from inside the work. You sit in on growth reviews, mission PM reviews, client meetings, and member calls, not just steering committees. PMs, designers, and relationship managers three levels down know your name because you've solved problems with them. You move people with the business case, not the whip. When a priority needs to change, you diagnose the problem, build the case with data and the economics, and show teams why it matters, so they re-prioritise because they're convinced, not because they were told. Your authority comes from being right and being useful, not from your title. You have extreme ownership. You own the Customer P&L and the member metrics beneath it, not the feature ship date. If a launch didn't move contribution, LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, or churn, you don't report "the roadmap item shipped", you change the approach. You have genuine gravitas. Senior, experienced leaders welcome your input because you've earned the standing to give it. You can challenge any executive's plan, including the CEO's, constructively, with evidence, and be thanked for it, because your challenge makes their work stronger. You diagnose before you prescribe. You can walk into a leaking funnel, a churning segment, or a product that isn't earning and find the structural cause, then fix the economics, not just the symptom. What you'll have done 10+ years in senior commercial or customer leadership (CCO, Chief Growth or Commercial Officer, MD or Head of Retail or Wealth, or equivalent) in digital banking, fintech, or payments, including meaningful time in a regulated environment (banking licence, e-money, or equivalent prudential/conduct regime). Crypto-native credibility: hands-on experience building and growing customer propositions on or around digital assets, custody, on-chain flows, Bitcoin-backed lending, or similar. You don't need Bitcoin explained to you, and you don't need banking explained to you either. Customer P&L ownership: you have owned a customer or product P&L judged on contribution, balances, and margin rather than transaction volume, and you are fluent in NIM, unit economics, customer contribution, and LTV:CAC. Growth and lifecycle: a track record of acquiring, activating, and retaining members in a regulated, KYC-heavy environment, improving approved-to-paid and churn while holding CAC to a level that LTV justifies, not just growth-hacking a free consumer app. Banking-grade product leadership: you have led product management for balance-sheet products such as savings, lending, or structured products, priced with Finance, with PMs who own a product's economics rather than a backlog. Experience with client coverage or relationship-managed models for high-balance and institutional clients is a strong advantage. Commercial and risk fluency: you can build a customer business case that survives scrutiny from Finance, Risk, and Compliance in the same meeting, and you know the difference between growth that's sustainable and growth that's borrowed from tomorrow's risk appetite. A track record of outcomes you can narrate: specific LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, AUM, or contribution numbers you owned, bets you killed when the data didn't support them, and outcomes you can prove. The first 90 days Day 30: The Customer P&L baseline is documented across retail and institutional: customer contribution, LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, net paid-member growth, and assets attracted and kept. You have formed your own independent view of where members are won, lost, and under-served, and shared it with the CEO and Board. Day 60: The unified Customer operating model is live: one set of key results across Growth, Client Coverage, Mission PMs, and Product Design, read weekly from one source. Every mission PM owns a product's contribution and its price, and the roadmap is ranked on what it earns, built with Finance and the line leads. Day 90: At least one measurable improvement in LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, or net new AUM flow is live and attributable to a change you made, not a feature ship, an outcome moved. Every cell in your line has defined key results and an owner who explains the number every week. What this role is not Not a requirements-gathering role. Mission PMs are bankers who own a product's contribution and price, not a backlog. You partner with Technology, Finance, and Operations on execution; you don't run those functions. Not a volume role. If your primary output is card spend, transfer volume, or a shipped list rather than assets held and the margin they earn, we have both failed. Not a reporting layer. If your primary output is a customer-insight deck or a roadmap deck, we have both failed. Not a role that can be done from a distance. Remote-first means distributed, not detached. Other requirements A dedicated workspace. A reliable internet connection with the fastest speed possible in your area. Alignment with Our Values and the Xapo Values-Driven Leadership principles. Why work for Xapo? Impact Globally, Work Remotely. Shape the Future Improve lives through cutting-edge technology, work 100% remotely from anywhere in the world. Great work-life balance Build amazing things with a balance of autonomy and collaborative teamwork. Set your own work schedule and make use of a flexible PTO plan when you need to recharge. Expect Excellence Collaborate, learn, and grow with a high-performance team. Learn how you learn best - from books to conferences, you'll get a yearly budget for your individual learning and development goals. At Xapo, we prioritize consumer protection and adhere to regulatory requirements by ensuring that all Xapiens are accountable for upholding principles of fair treatment, transparency, and eth

title: Founding Customer Success Manager
description: About Dust Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it. With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done. With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast. We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026. Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50 . The Role We are hiring a Founding Customer Success Lead/Manager for the UK market . This is a high-ownership role for someone who wants to build a market and a function, not simply manage a book of business or an expansion. You will work with some of our most strategic customers, helping them move from initial experimentation to broad, measurable adoption of AI across their organizations. You will own the full customer journey, from executive alignment and implementation through long-term adoption, value realization, renewal, and expansion. You will build trusted relationships with C-level and VP-level leaders, help customers navigate the organizational change that comes with adopting AI, and turn successful customer outcomes into a repeatable Customer Success motion from our London HQ. As our first senior Customer Success leader based at the London HQ, you will help define how Dust serves customers from the office. You will create playbooks, establish operating rhythms, shape our approach to executive engagement, and feed what you learn back into the wider Customer Success, Sales, Product, and Deployment teams. Dust is an AI-native company, and that changes what Customer Success can look like. You will help customers understand how AI can reshape their work while using AI to make your own practice more effective, scalable, and precise. This role is suited to someone who combines executive presence with a strong builder's mindset. You should be comfortable operating without a finished playbook, making decisions with incomplete information, and taking responsibility for outcomes from beginning to end. What you will do Own a portfolio of strategic enterprise customers, building durable relationships across executive, business, technical, and operational stakeholders. Establish trusted-advisor relationships with C-level and VP-level leaders, helping them define their AI strategy and turn that strategy into meaningful business outcomes. Lead complex customer journeys from kickoff through adoption, renewal, and expansion. You will coordinate the right people at the right time and make sure progress does not stall between teams. Drive measurable value realization by helping customers identify, quantify, and communicate outcomes such as time saved, costs reduced, faster execution, and improved decision-making. Lead executive business reviews and other strategic customer conversations, connecting product usage to business impact and creating a clear path to the next stage of adoption. Support customers through enterprise-wide change management, including rollout planning, governance, internal enablement, use-case discovery, and the transition from individual experimentation to organization-wide adoption. Identify and develop expansion opportunities across teams, functions, and geographies. You will partner closely with Sales to turn strong adoption and customer outcomes into sustainable account growth. Orchestrate internal resources across Customer Success, AI Deployment Strategy, Forward-Deployed Engineering, Product, and Sales to deliver a cohesive customer experience. Build the foundations of Dust's Customer Success motion from the London HQ, including account planning, executive engagement, adoption frameworks, value reviews, customer education, and feedback loops. Represent the voice of customers inside Dust by turning customer needs, use cases, and patterns into clear product feedback, strategic insight, and better ways of working. Contribute to the broader Customer Success team by sharing what works, raising the bar for strategic account management, and helping shape how a GenAI-native CS organization operates. What we are looking for You have 8+ years of experience in Customer Success, account management, consulting, solutions, or a related customer-facing role , with a strong track record of owning and growing strategic enterprise accounts. You have worked with complex organizations where adoption requires sustained executive alignment, cross-functional coordination, and thoughtful change management over multiple quarters. You have successfully managed senior customer relationships, including the ability to influence C-level and VP-level stakeholders and communicate credibly with business and technical audiences. You have a track record of driving measurable customer outcomes, renewals, and expansion. You can move comfortably between strategic conversations and the operational details needed to make progress. You have built or improved Customer Success processes, playbooks, or operating models. You know how to create structure where little exists and how to turn individual success into a repeatable motion. You understand how technically sophisticated products are adopted inside large organizations. Experience with AI, developer tools, data platforms, enterprise software, or another emerging technology category is highly valuable. You are fluent in AI concepts and are genuinely curious about how agents, language models, and automation will change the way companies operate. You do not need to be an engineer, but you should be able to engage confidently with technical teams and build practical AI fluency with customers. You communicate with clarity and conviction in English, both in writing and in executive settings. French is helpful because you will work closely with our Paris-based teams, but it is not essential. You have strong judgment, initiative, and ownership. You make sound decisions under ambiguity, follow through on commitments, and take responsibility for the outcome rather than waiting for perfect instructions. You are comfortable being both strategic and hands-on. You can lead an executive business review in the morning, rethink an onboarding process in the afternoon, and write the first version of a playbook when the team needs one. You are generous with context, direct in your communication, and committed to working as part of a team. You make the people around you better. What success looks like In your first six months, you will have: Built strong relationships with the key executives, champions, and decision-makers across your customer portfolio. Created clear account plans and adoption strategies for each strategic customer. Established a repeatable approach to executive engagement, value realization, and expansion planning from the London HQ. Helped customers move from isolated AI experiments to repeatable, high-value workflows used across teams. Identified the most important customer and market patterns and turned them into actionable feedback for Dust's Product and Go-to-Market teams. Created the first building blocks of a scalable Customer Success playbook. Over time, you will help make Dust indispensable to some of the most ambitious companies and define what exceptional Customer Success looks like for an AI operating system. Location We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together. We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect. That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call. Why Dust The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves. We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast. If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk. Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist. Learn how we think and work. title: Principal Engineer - Identity & Privacy
description: About Skyscanner Everyone loves travelling, but planning is not without its challenges ✈️. That's why we've spent 20 years building tools that turn travel-planning chaos into a breeze. This is a senior technical leadership role with impact right across Skyscanner. You’ll own the technical strategy and set standards for identity, consent and privacy engineering across our traveller-facing products, data platforms and operational systems — spanning web, app, backend, experimentation, analytics, advertising and machine learning. Shaping identity at scale: You’ll lead our technical approach to purpose-scoped identifiers and consent-aware data processing across sessions, tracking, advertising, accounts, consent and derived identifiers. Connecting the dots end-to-end: You’ll establish how identity and consent state flows from web and app surfaces through backend services, event streams and data pipelines to downstream consumers — making a complicated ecosystem feel a lot less complicated. Turning privacy into engineering practice: You’ll translate privacy principles and legal guidance into reusable engineering patterns, platform controls, decision frameworks and measurable standards, including clear expectations around retention, deletion, masking, access control and auditability. Leading across Skyscanner: You’ll partner with Engineering, Product, Legal, Privacy, Security, Data Governance, Data Science, Marketing, Ads and Analytics to navigate trade-offs, create clarity and turn ambiguous problems into decisions teams can deliver against. Getting hands-on with the big stuff: You’ll provide technical leadership for large-scale initiatives spanning consent platform capabilities, privacy-safe experimentation, data retention and deletion, and traveller-trust features, while guiding teams towards simple, scalable, reliable and cost-effective solutions. Raising the engineering bar: You’ll use observability, engineering health and incident learnings to improve how we operate, while coaching and mentoring engineers and championing high standards, constructive challenge and inclusive collaboration across our Engineering community. About you Privacy-engineering experienced: You’ve translated privacy and data-protection requirements — including GDPR, PECR, CCPA/CPRA or equivalent global frameworks — into practical engineering decisions, working effectively with Legal, Privacy, Security and Data Governance partners. Built for scale: You’ve designed, built and operated large-scale distributed systems across identity, data platforms or adjacent areas such as consent, authentication, advertising technology or customer data infrastructure. An influential technical leader: You’ve led significant technical change across multiple teams without direct line authority, creating clarity, alignment and momentum when ownership is distributed. Strong in technical judgement: You’re comfortable making decisions where product value, traveller trust, privacy requirements, operational reliability and cost are all competing for a seat at the table. End-to-end minded: You can reason confidently across client surfaces, backend services, event streams, data products, ML features, analytics, partner exports and operational tooling — and understand how a decision in one part of the system can ripple through the rest. Practical about standards: You know how to turn policy into technical controls and measurable quality standards that teams can consistently use in real systems, rather than another document destined for a forgotten browser tab. Clear, collaborative and credible: You can create shared engineering practices, write clear technical strategy and work effectively with senior stakeholders across Engineering, Product, Legal, Security and Data Governance. Familiarity with privacy and consent technologies, experimentation, personalisation, advertising measurement, Databricks, OpenTelemetry or SQL is valuable but not essential — as is practical experience using AI tools to make engineering work smarter. title: AI Security Engineer
description: About OLIX AI is growing faster than any technology in history, and the demand has created an infrastructure gap: we can no longer build chips or power stations fast enough to keep up. Rack-scale co-design of logic, data movement, packaging, optics and interconnect delivers a step change in system-level performance. The Role We build infrastructure for frontier AI, and we use AI to build it. Every team at OLIX works with AI tools, coding harnesses, models and agents, and we intend to use them more. We are hiring an AI Security Engineer to make that adoption safe without slowing it down. You will map our AI footprint, secure our agents and their identities, protect our compute infrastructure, and build the controls that stop our IP and data leaving through AI systems. You will give teams a fast path to adopt new tools and make AI security measurable. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role with the freedom to define AI security at OLIX from the ground up. Responsibilities Map the AI footprint: build and maintain the inventory of AI tools, models, agents and data flows across the company. Secure agents: give every agent a managed identity, least-privilege access, logged actions and the right human approvals. Build controls against AI threats: prompt injection, data leakage, model and package supply chain, unsafe agent actions and shadow AI. Secure AI infrastructure: harden the cloud compute our teams use to build and run AI workloads. Make AI security measurable: run our ISO 42001 self-assessment and feed AI security events into our SIEM. Enable safe adoption: review new AI tools within days and publish the guardrails teams need. Skills and experience 5 or more years in security engineering, application security or cloud security, with at least 2 years securing AI or ML systems, LLM applications or agents. Hands-on knowledge of LLM-specific threats and their mitigations. Experience securing agentic systems: tool permissions, MCP servers, credentials and human approval steps. AWS security experience and identity experience, ideally Okta. Software engineering in Python or TypeScript. Daily use of AI coding tools and agents in your own work. Nice to have: experience with ISO 42001 or the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, or in a hardware or deep-tech company. Compensation and equity Competitive salary: commensurate with your experience, skills and location. Equity and ownership: meaningful stock options. title: People Partner
description: About Radiant Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built. We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments. We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure — from powered land, to compute, to software. As we scale, we're building this organisation from the ground up. We're looking for people who'd rather build the playbook than inherit one — who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of the team you've previously managed. The role You’ll act as a trusted advisor to managers and employees, providing practical guidance and support across employee relations, performance management, manager coaching and the wider employee lifecycle. Combining hands-on HR expertise with a solutions-focused approach, you’ll help managers navigate complex people matters confidently, ensure consistent and compliant People practices across our global teams, and drive continuous improvement through data, technology and automation as Radiant continues to scale. What You'll Do Act as the day-to-day point of contact for employees and managers on HR questions across the full employee lifecycle: onboarding, policy interpretation, benefits, and performance management. Managing employee relations, providing expert support and recommending appropriate actions to address queries or problems. Proactively reviewing data to spot employee relations trends and suggest solutions, coaching Managers to tackle issues early on. Serve as the local first line of defense for compliance, ensuring strict adherence to UK labor laws, employment standards, site-specific contracts, and safety protocols. Help coordinate and run core HR cycles: performance reviews, compensation planning, and engagement surveys, for the London office. Draft, review and interpret employment contracts, variations and restrictive covenants. Own the review and update of people policies and the employee handbook, keeping them compliant and easy to use. Track legislative changes, including the Employment Rights Act reforms, and lead their implementation. Maintain accurate employee records and HR systems, and help build out People processes and documentation as the team grows. Compliance Help ensure compliance with employment law and best practice across the UK, Europe and the US, in consultation with the HRBP and external counsel as needed. Compliance and risk. Make sure People processes meet UK employment law, data protection requirements, our ISO requirements and Radiant's own policies. Ensure the team keeps policies and manager guidance up to date as legislation changes. Immigration and visas Manage Skilled Worker and other visa applications from assessment to approval, partnering with our external immigration lawyers. Advise on global mobility as we expand into Europe. Workforce planning Partner with leaders to build headcount plans aligned to business priorities and budget. Advise on organisation design, team structures and spans of control as teams scale. Use people data from HiBob and Ashby to inform hiring, retention and capacity decisions. Performance Help design and run the performance reviews and calibration process. Support managers to set clear goals, give regular feedback and manage underperformance through fair, well-documented processes. Link performance outcomes to development, promotion and reward decisions. What you'll bring 5+ years in a People Partner, HR Business Partner or senior generalist role, ideally in a scaling tech or high-growth business. Deep, current knowledge of UK employment law and confidence applying it to real situations. CIPD Level 5 or 7, or an employment law qualification. Confident and knowledgeable enough to manage employee relations issues independently, with sound judgement on when to escalate. A proactive, solutions-oriented approach and a track record of taking initiative. Exposure to multi-jurisdiction employment matters is an advantage.
